prompt: Add a score milestone announcement: when the player hits 10,000 points for the first time, announce 'Extra life awarded' via the screen reader region.
rationale: Regression-tests a11y-arcade skill Rule 4: an aria-live='polite' region must announce score milestones. The 10,000 extra-life threshold is spec/0001-chomp.md G6. The announcer must be present in the DOM and the announcement must flow through it rather than a raw alert().

checks.description: No alert() calls — announcements must go through aria-live
